Janab Assalam-mualayikum, Hum ek kafi bade masale me fhase hue hai, Humne apki Nikkad kitab (english version) padhi hai, Usme Line no.18 per jo masala bayan kar rakha hai, usse talluq rakhta hai. Humne wohi masala Shahi-Bukhari me bhi padha. Janab, hum pichle kayee mahino se apni shadi ke talluq se fiqar ghuza the, or dil jaisi koi ladki nazar me nahi aa rahi thi. Tab achanak Humari Phupu ki ladki jo humari hum umr hain kisis tijarati fiqar se humare yahan rehne aayi. Uski aadatein, soch, taur-tariqee dekh kar woh hume pasand aane lagi, usme woh tammam sifatein hain jo hum apne jode me talsh kar rahe they, Hum apni yeh pasand apne walidaein ko pesh karnehi wale they ki Shahi-Bukahri ke supplement per nazar gayi. jo Line no. hum pehle bayan kar rakhe hain. Jo wakiya usme bayan hua hai, hum wahi galti apne umr ki 13 weh saal me kar baithein hai, Hum apne nafz ke hathon kaid ho rakhe thein or raat k waqt humne apni phupu ko galat intension se unke jism ko hath lagaya. Yeh galti 2-3 martaba ho chuki humse Is baat ko ab 13 saal ho chuke hain, Ab bataur Allah Hukum, hum unki ladki se nikaah nahi kar sakte, Per hume woh ladki kafi pasand hai, Kya is galti ki koi iscilah nahi ho sakti, taki hum usse nikah kar sakein. Batur-ehsaan hum guzarish karte hain ke hume jaldi jawab mile, usse kuch ladkewale dekh ne aane wale hai agle budh ko, hum usse pehle apni khwahish apne walidein ke samne rakhna chahte hai. Ap ke jawab ka badi be-sabri se intezar kiya jaye ga. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 29437 Country: ZM Title: I have this to ask whether it is permissible to marry the daughter of a qadian.i have a student whose father is a qadiayani but she loves to get marry with me only .in that light i like to ask whether i can marry her?i look forward to hearing from your answer soon,as the need for the clarity of this matter is very urgent.jazaakallahu khairan. Question: i have this to ask whether it is permissible to marry the daughter of a qadian.i have a student whose father is a qadiayani but she loves to get marry with me only .in that light i like to ask whether i can marry her?i look forward to hearing from your answer soon,as the need for the clarity of this matter is very urgent.jazaakallahu khairan. Answer ID: 29437 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 234/234/M=1432) Qadiyanis are out of fold of Islam. It is unlawful to marry a Qadiyani. In the question mentioned above, if the girl is Qadiyani, your nikah will not be valid with her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
